metadata.title: MurderBall Wheelchair Rugby Intelligence Complete Machine-Readable Data Inventory
metadata.copyright_notice: Primary PDF source books (IPC/WWR) are retained locally for verification only and are NOT redistributed without permission.

source_registry.dataset_name: Paris 2024 Paralympic Games Wheelchair Rugby Results Book
source_registry.publisher: International Paralympic Committee (IPC) / Paris 2024 Organising Committee
source_registry.source_type: Official C73 & C74 PDF Results Book
source_registry.known_limitations: Event play-by-play logs scoring and timeouts; individual assist blocks and physical impact forces not recorded in PDF.

source_registry.dataset_name: Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games Wheelchair Rugby Results Book
source_registry.publisher: International Paralympic Committee (IPC) / Tokyo 2020 Organising Committee
source_registry.source_type: Official C73 & C74 PDF Results Book
source_registry.known_limitations: Event play-by-play logs scoring and timeouts; assist blocks not broken out in separate box score column.

source_registry.dataset_name: Rio 2016 Paralympic Games Wheelchair Rugby Results Book
source_registry.publisher: International Paralympic Committee (IPC) / Rio 2016 Organising Committee
source_registry.known_limitations: Double overtime gold medal match reconstructed; substitution timing grouped into stint intervals.

source_registry.dataset_name: London 2012 Paralympic Games Wheelchair Rugby Results Book
source_registry.known_limitations: Pre-2021 classification rules (strict 8.0 base, no female allowance).

source_registry.dataset_name: Beijing 2008 Paralympic Games Wheelchair Rugby Results Book
source_registry.source_type: Official PDF Results Book with Detailed C73 Box Scores
source_registry.known_limitations: Explicit assist blocks (AB) tracked; second-by-second continuous stint intervals require box-score time inference.

source_registry.dataset_name: Athens 2004 Paralympic Games Wheelchair Rugby Results Book
source_registry.source_type: Official PDF Results Book with Detailed C73 Box Scores
source_registry.known_limitations: Assist blocks (AB) tracked; 1,296 AB defensive denominator across Athens & Beijing.

source_registry.publisher: World Wheelchair Rugby (WWR) / Brazilian Paralympic Committee
source_registry.source_document: Centro de Treinamento Paralímpico Brasileiro Match Logs
source_registry.known_limitations: Games 1-24 form frozen prospective evaluation cohort; Games 25-46 feature in-tournament rating evolution.

source_registry.dataset_name: Official World Wheelchair Rugby (WWR) World Rankings
source_registry.known_limitations: Contains 32 ranked members and 8 unranked members. Preserves Israel points='c' and Poland arithmetic inconsistency.

flagged_anomalies.description: Malformed character 'c' present in official WWR DOM snapshot instead of numeric float.
Internal arithmetic mismatch: 41.60 - 4.60 = 37.00, but official difference recorded as 0.
